save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint to disk at the end of an epoch or after N updates
load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint and restore the training iterator, optimizer, and learning rate scheduler
load_checkpoint_to_cpu: load a checkpoint to CPU memory with backward compatibility upgrades for older model formats
load_model_ensemble_and_task: load an ensemble of models and their task configuration from checkpoint files
delete_old_checkpoint_files: delete old checkpoint files based on keep_last_updates or keep_last_epochs configuration
